messages:
anya: CI red on `serializer-output-goldens` for PR #4122 — failing 3 tests, looks like prompt formatting drift. first seen on main@f1a2c3.
ben: ack, can you paste the failing diff or a short snippet? :eyes:
ci-bot: build: https://ci.internal.redwood/1876543209 — job: serializer-output-goldens
ci-bot: failing tests: `prompt_render_test`, `serialization_roundtrip_test`, `golden_variants_test`
carmen: first glance: leading whitespace in prompt templates changed, might be from the new template-merge logic in utils/templater.py
anya: here's the relevant log block: ```
--- expected:
"Hello, user!"
+++ actual:
"Hello, user! 
"
diff shows an extra trailing space/newline in generated prompt
```
ben: hm, could be a serialization tweak or the templater change — can we rerun just the golden suite on this PR?
ci-bot: queued rerun: `./scripts/ci rerun --job serializer-output-goldens --pr 4122` (started)
ci-bot: rerun completed — same failures.
jamie: can we bisect between main@f1a2c3 and main@e9d8b7 to see when the spacing got introduced? I can run a local bisect if you want.
carmen: +1 to bisect, but quick triage: try `GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 pytest tests/goldens/test_prompt_render.py::test_prompt_render -k pr_4122` locally to see if updating goldens makes tests pass — don't commit updates unless we confirm correctness.
anya: doing local bisect now, command I'm running: `git bisect start f1a2c3 e9d8b7 && git bisect run ./tools/check-goldens.sh`
ben: if bisect points to templater change, we should land a minimal fix to strip trailing spaces in templater render and add unit test.
ci-bot: note: flaky history for `golden_variants_test` — 5 failures in last 30 days, but this pattern (extra trailing space) is new.
anya: bisect found culprit: commit b3c4d5 (PR #4098) — templater merge introduced `join` change. I'll open a tiny PR to trim trailing whitespace on render and add a regression golden.
carmen: sounds good, also add an eval harness check for prompt normalization to avoid future drift.
ben: ping me on the PR for quick review, can cut a patch release if green. :+1:
anya: thanks — will update here when PR is up and CI is green.
